rationale: The prompt requires Package the merged changes into release notes for users and an internal changelog section for support. Do not inspect CI unless a release blocker is mentioned; the anchored # Changelog Generator explicitly scopes the source-visible workflow to Generate or update a repository CHANGELOG.md in Keep a Changelog format from git history - grouping commits since the last tag into Added/Changed/Deprecated/Removed/Fixed/Security, rewriting them as user-facing entries. That scope directly supports the requested input, transformation, and deliverable rather than leaving a material component unaddressed.
